title: Importing a Joomla site with a non-English administrator installs Claude Cowork instead of failing with install_failed
steps: S1: Run node --test packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/install-language.test.mjs (a fake Joomla 6 administrator in Polish, driven through the real installCowork).
expect: S1: 2 tests, 2 pass, 0 fail: an install that worked returns ok with the component's token and version; an install the site refused returns install_failed after trying both the URL door and the upload door.
evidence: Production 12/10/2026 12:37 UTC: the first real import (coachingnvc.pl, Joomla 6.1.4, admin pl-pl) raised site.stuck installing/install_failed after 8 seconds because the success sentence was Polish
fence: Install success is decided by the component answering on its own token at the latest version, not by the language of Joomla's flash message
